content: To investigate the effectiveness of our expectation inference method, we compare it against a majority voting approach, a strong baseline in truth inference BIBREF16. Figure FIGREF36 shows the result of this evaluation. We observe that our approach results in better models for both CyberAttack and PoliticianDeath. Our manual investigation reveals that workers' annotations are of high reliability, which explains the relatively good performance of majority voting. Despite limited margin for improvement, our method of expectation inference improves the performance of majority voting by $0.4\%$ and $1.19\%$ AUC on CyberAttack and PoliticianDeath, respectively.
